property_summary: After owner calls AdjustBetAmounts(any) with difficulty initially 0, the reference keeps difficulty 0 but the mutant sets it to 0 (same value), so the previous assertion failed; differentiating via revert difference: after adjusting betLimit to 0, the reference's wager() reverts due to msg.value == betLimit (0) but also emits, while the bug obscures onlyOwner checks; however, the key divergence is that calling AdjustBetAmounts(0) then wager() with value 0 fails on reference because wagers[msg.sender] == 0 check (requires wagers == 0) passes, but reference works; actually the simplest: after owner calls AdjustBetAmounts(10), the reference's difficulty() remains 0, mutant's difficulty() is set to 0 same; difference is that mutant's onlyOwner also changes difficulty to 0 during owner calls, but if difficulty was initially non-zero (e.g., 5), reference keeps 5, mutant sets to 0. So: first owner calls AdjustDifficulty(5), then owner calls AdjustBetAmounts(10), assert difficulty() == 5 on reference, != 5 on mutant.
change_summary: Replace the modifier body with an assignment to difficulty instead of the require.
